mechanism: PREM_CAPITULATION -> FLOW_IGNITION (same symbol, <=12h) -> liq_cascade event (<=4h after ignition) -> fade outcome on final cascade
distinctness: Genuine 3-dataset, 3-step sequential chain (premium_dataset -> ignition_dataset -> liq_cascade_dataset), the only true 3-leg construction in this axis besides w1_b02/w1_b17's 2-leg chains; N is necessarily small since it requires all 3 stages to confirm in sequence
